safety: one authoritative core and event envelope
idempotency key blocks duplicate effects
import preview and validation before write
snapshot before restore, migration, or import promotion
encrypted write followed by decrypt and durable read-back
rollback with raw-vault read-back on failure
strict reversal topology with legacy one-to-one compatibility
no direct deletion of protected history
pre-4.2 obligations retain original total-split semantics
cancelled records are filtered before live render/list counting and remain in durable history
Calendar source HTML omits cancelled counter and cancelled filter; cancelled records remain in durable history
Calendar month and list use the same green/yellow/red status signal
owner dashboard reads current cash, stock and live Calendar state without mutating durable data
owner dashboard red metric counts only active outgoing items due in the current month and displays item count only
4.2.6 owns the visible product version through one shared runtime authority value
daily target progress is derived from current-day Store sales plus Ride jobs and does not create competing money truth
end-day obligation selection previews the resulting balance without mutation; stale or VERIFY items remain disabled
confirmed end-day obligation payments use existing Ledger and Calendar mutation paths and one durable commit
manual Start Day and End Day persist state.sync.flow.dayCycle without changing State Schema 4 or deleting source history
End Day always creates a durable closure even when no obligation payment is selected and safely closes an active Ride round
Maintenance no longer exposes duplicate Reconcile; stock and cash corrections remain with their existing source-specific owners
FLOW_ICONS remains the legacy shared geometry source while the remaster layer synchronizes its production glyphs from one new 24px icon authority
index.html owns the single five-destination bottom navigation source; the remaster hydrates icons without creating a competing navigation tree
METROPOLIS is the primary visible product name and YGPH — Yggdrasil Personal Helper is its signature
manual stock adjustment records before, delta, after, reason, actor and time without creating an automatic Ledger transaction
manual stock adjustment history lives in state.store.adjustments without changing state schema or IndexedDB version
historical stock reports reconstruct from durable current stock plus signed source movements; the Maintenance adapter recognizes RECONSTRUCTED_V2 and never corrects it twice
partial reset preserves durable sales, purchases, ride jobs, Ledger transactions and source-linked Calendar history
Factory Reset deletes the complete stock-pocket-secure IndexedDB so Vault, rollback data and trusted-device key are removed together
Full Local Cleanup additionally removes METROPOLIS app/meta caches and unregisters the current service worker, and is blocked while offline
destructive reset requires typed confirmation and database deletion read-back before success
maintenance logic, browser reset adapter, report adapter and UI styles are separate production modules to reduce future rewiring
visual remaster logic and CSS are additive UI-only modules loaded after Maintenance and do not write durable state
Metro Visual System V2 resolves legacy light/dark cascade conflicts through the existing final remaster authority instead of adding another global CSS layer
scoped final rules keep the app bar, primary hero value, Ride round panel, Calendar focus panel and Calendar swipe card readable on the dark shell
Home, Store, Ride, Ledger, Calendar, Settings and Recovery share one dark token system and one icon stroke/grid contract
visual remaster retains State Schema 4, IndexedDB version 1, Vault format 1 and all existing money ownership semantics
classic production scripts share one collision-tested realm and extension cores remain isolated from browser runtime globals
Calendar has one render lifecycle, stable queue identities and one three-action mutation owner across direct-day and swipe views
Store and obligation forms reveal optional details only on request while retaining their existing durable command owners
Vault writes preflight storage capacity, roll back on quota failure and expose read-only capacity guidance without automatic history deletion
stock adjustments and protected histories are append-only evidence; capacity levels trigger backup guidance rather than destructive cleanup
durable commands disable live controls before the first asynchronous boundary and restore exact prior button states after success or failure
production manifest, Cloudflare allowlist and offline shell are regression-locked against drift
every production UI change advances the service-worker cache/release generation
all normal durable persistence entry points pass through one command runtime gate before the existing Vault commit engine
the command runtime gate re-reads durable Vault revision before commit and blocks stale cross-context writes before encryption or database mutation
successful guarded writes require matching durable read-back revision and publish the new revision to sibling contexts when BroadcastChannel is available
persistent browser storage and cross-context transport availability are diagnostic health signals and never replace durable Vault truth
